title: Aniccam
text: 1 Evam me sutaṃ || Sāvatthiyaṃ || || 2 Tatra kho || || 3 Rūpam bhikkhave aniccaṃ || pe || || 4-6 Vedanā aniccā || Sāññā aniccā || Saṅkhārā aniccā || Viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ || 7 Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim pi nibbindati || Vedanāya pi nibbindati || Saññāya pi nibbindati || Saṅkhāresu pi nibbindati || Viññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
